mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO sys_scene_config (scene_id, scene_name, type_value, algorithm_code, creator, create_time, delete_flag, tenant_id, industry_code, app_ver_code) VALUES
(#{item.sceneId}, #{item.sceneName}, #{item.typeValue}, #{item.algorithmCode}, #{item.creator}, NOW(), 0, #{item.tenantId}, #{item.industryCode}, #{item.appVerCode})

INSERT INTO sys_scene_alarm_rel (scene_id, alarm_type, alarm_type_name, algorithm_code, creator, create_time, delete_flag, tenant_id, industry_code, app_ver_code) VALUES
(#{item.sceneId}, #{item.alarmType}, #{item.alarmTypeName}, #{item.algorithmCode}, #{item.creator}, NOW(), 0, #{item.tenantId}, #{item.industryCode}, #{item.appVerCode})

INSERT INTO sys_alarm_type (alarm_source, type_value, type_name, source, delete_flag, creator, create_time, tenant_id, industry_code) VALUES
(#{item.alarmSource}, #{item.typeValue}, #{item.typeName}, #{item.source}, 0, #{item.creator}, NOW(), #{item.tenantId}, #{item.industryCode})
